arguments.name: statutoryCode
arguments.description:
When the user provides a statutory item code, this is used for an exact match search.
Triggers the Search action with criteria = STA_CODE and returns the matching grid record(s). (e.g., "000005").

raw.name: statutoryCode
raw.description:
When the user provides a statutory item code, this is used for an exact match search.
Triggers the Search action with criteria = STA_CODE and returns the matching grid record(s). (e.g., "000005").

arguments.name: statutoryName
arguments.description:
When the user provides a statutory item name (full or partial), this performs a case-insensitive partial match search.
Triggers the Search action with criteria = STA_NAME and returns all matching grid rows. (e.g., "Gratuity", "EPF").

raw.name: statutoryName
raw.description:
When the user provides a statutory item name (full or partial), this performs a case-insensitive partial match search.
Triggers the Search action with criteria = STA_NAME and returns all matching grid rows. (e.g., "Gratuity", "EPF").

arguments.name: returnAll
arguments.description:
When user asks to return all/available/existing statutory items, set this to one of:
"true", "yes", "all", "1", "showall", "returnall", "available", "existing", "list"
Triggers Show All and returns every grid row.

raw.name: returnAll
raw.description:
When user asks to return all/available/existing statutory items, set this to one of:
"true", "yes", "all", "1", "showall", "returnall", "available", "existing", "list"
Triggers Show All and returns every grid row.

arguments.name: autoFetchAllPages
arguments.description:
Controls paging behavior when returnAll is used.
"true" = loop all pages (default when returnAll is truthy)
"false" = return only page 1 and provide nextPage + moreAvailable

raw.name: autoFetchAllPages
raw.description:
Controls paging behavior when returnAll is used.
"true" = loop all pages (default when returnAll is truthy)
"false" = return only page 1 and provide nextPage + moreAvailable

arguments.name: pageNumber
arguments.description: Page to fetch when not auto-looping (default "1"). Example: "2"

raw.name: pageNumber
raw.description: Page to fetch when not auto-looping (default "1"). Example: "2"

arguments.name: pageSize
arguments.description: Page size sent to the grid pager (server may cap it). Default: "100". Example: "200"

raw.name: pageSize
raw.description: Page size sent to the grid pager (server may cap it). Default: "100". Example: "200"

arguments.name: maxPages
arguments.description: Safety cap to prevent infinite loops. Default: "50". Example: "10"
